chunks.text: Anthropic shares have fallen below their $83 IPO price. TechCrunch reports the stock traded as low as $76 by midday Tuesday. That's down nearly 12% from Monday's close. Observers see it as a barometer for AI valuations. TechCrunch says a weak run could pressure startup valuations and AI IPOs. Nvidia also fell more than 7% by midday. The Motley Fool says nine-month revenue surged 1,200% to $33.24 billion. Does this change how your company chooses its AI providers?
